title: Embodied navigation
motivation: 传统绝对坐标系导航无法应对无GPS/地图的水下/地下/未知环境导航需求
problem_framing: 将导航重新定义为智能体与物理世界交互获取局部地图、定位并优化路线的范式
key_insight: 传感数据本身（而非地图）引导移动，感知空间构成与R³等距的Banach空间
method_signature: 系统性综述：感知→导航→效率优化→新兴任务四维度分类框架
evaluation_criteria: 综述类论文无原创实验，评估基于现有benchmark综合比较
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: sophisticated navigation tasks remain a formidable challenge for AI agents
evidence_for_taste: Is this the only necessary way to navigate?
sensing data alone, without being mapped to the physical world, may be sufficient
The key to finding such subspace is to define a distance-preserving map function f
robustness improvement from these hand-crafted strategies is relatively limited
thinking_moves: 从传统绝对坐标框架跳脱，质疑地图的必要性
用数学公理化（Theorem 1）重新定义传感数据空间
将导航问题重新框架为 sensation space 等距嵌入问题
系统分类而非提出新方法，体现工程整合思维
